description: This file defines a PHP class Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy that extends a socket-based HTTP client adapter to support proxy connections, including handling HTTPS CONNECT handshake and proxy authorization.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy
classes.description: A PHP class extending socket adapter to support proxy connections, including handling HTTPS tunneling and proxy authorization.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the proxy server or falls back to direct connection if no proxy is configured.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request through the proxy, handling proxy authorization and HTTPS CONNECT handshake if needed.

methods.name: connectHandshake
methods.description: Performs the CONNECT method handshake to establish a secure tunnel through the proxy for HTTPS.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection and resets negotiation state.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that ensures the socket is closed when the object is destroyed.
